lead: The captured records show active customer acquisition across EFB and flight planning platforms, with IFS securing LCC commitments and Jeppesen leading in product rollouts. Meanwhile, Lufthansa Systems attracted market attention regarding a potential unit sale.

insights.title: IFS secures multiple LCC and regional carrier commitments
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFBOne customer base by securing commitments from fastjet, MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is classified as an LCC, and TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captures reflect vendor-announced selections and implementations rather than full fleet operational status.

insights.title: Jeppesen expands product portfolio with artificial intelligence and hardware support
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced artificial intelligence capabilities through ForeFlight Airflow and added support for Apple iPhone Duo via OzRunways.
insights.aviation_context: Enhancements target commercial flight crew workflows and cockpit device compatibility.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems explores corporate restructuring via unit sale
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems reportedly explored the sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine provide critical flight planning and network management software to global airlines.
insights.caveat: Based on press reports rather than finalized corporate transactions.

insights.title: Navblue integrates TransNusa into Skywise portfolio
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue by adopting Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+.
insights.aviation_context: Integration combines flight operations and technical fleet health monitoring.
insights.caveat: Limited to publicly announced software adoption agreements.

insights.title: Aviobook signs long-term EFB agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales subsidiary Aviobook signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to supply the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is a full-service flag carrier.
insights.caveat: Contract duration and scope are based on vendor announcements.
